gloss: tomb raider; grave robber; illegal excavator

definitions.gloss: tomb raider; grave robber; illegal excavator
definitions.explanation: A person who illegally digs up tombs, ancient ruins, or protected sites to steal artifacts or valuables. Also used for those who illegally collect plants or minerals from protected land.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古墳|こふん}→古墳：11853_kofun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{盗掘者|とうくつしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荒|あ}らされた→荒らす：14057_arasu⟧。
examples.english: The ancient tomb was ransacked by tomb raiders.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{盗掘者|とうくつしゃ}⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}した→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧。
examples.english: The police arrested a group of tomb raiders.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{盗掘者|とうくつしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦パトロール→パトロール：11591_patorooru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}→強化：00260_kyouka⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Patrols have been stepped up around the ruins to prevent tomb raiders.

notes:
Compound of {盗掘|とうくつ} (illegal excavation; tomb robbing) + the suffix ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person who does —). {盗|とう} carries the sense of "stealing," {掘|くつ} means "to dig."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盗掘者|とうくつしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われる→襲う：01915_osou⟧: to be raided by tomb robbers
- {盗掘者|とうくつしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|つか}まえる→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧: to catch tomb robbers
- {盗掘者|とうくつしゃ}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: countermeasures against tomb robbing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {墓荒|はかあ}らし: grave robbing; grave robber — more colloquial; can refer to the act or the person
- ⟦{泥棒|どろぼう}→泥棒：01688_dorobou⟧: thief — general word for any thief
